questions.question: Scope for BK-425? Orient found BK-384 and BK-346 constrain it (ADR chain + ripple rows as inputs); BK-404/ID-266/ID-268 unrelated.

options.label: Contract + stop clause (Recommended)
options.description: Fold proposal 9 into the existing subject list (one list, not two): each row gets platforms/edge cases, evidence mark, known risk. Scoped briefs must carry the open rows; a new stop clause says the loop ends only when every row is covered or waived. New ADR-0044 amending ADR-0033 (the record holding the stop clauses), CLAUDE.md 'five records' → six, BK-384 dossier noted. Net-zero bytes via cuts in ship/SKILL.md.

options.label: Skill-only, no stop clause
options.description: Same row shape and briefs must carry open rows, but no new stop clause and no ADR. Cheaper and smaller, but a loop can still converge with a not-reached row untouched, which is the exact run B failure.

options.label: Contract only in handoff
options.description: Just widen the handoff's row content; review rounds unchanged. Minimal, mostly documentary; does not fix the 'nothing required a reviewer to take it up' gap.

options.label: Wait for BK-384's sample
options.description: Defer so a new clause does not confound RFC-0015's three-delivery measurement. Leaves the run B gap open for those deliveries.

questions.question: Who may waive a contract row the loop did not cover?

options.label: User, in one dialog (Recommended)
options.description: At the close, uncovered rows go to the user in one AskUserQuestion; a waived row is recorded with its reason in the Step 5 report. Stops a cheap loop waiving its own gaps; costs one dialog only when rows remain.

options.label: Orchestrator, with reason
options.description: The orchestrator waives with a stated reason in the Step 5 report. No extra dialog, but the session that wants to stop is the one deciding coverage.

questions.question: Run the full local gate (`hatch run all`) now? The diff changes only Markdown, YAML and JSON (no source or test files), and lint, the digest and the budget already pass. `/pr`'s validation step normally runs it too.

options.label: Run it once now (Recommended)
options.description: One foreground `hatch run all` before commit. /pr then reuses that result and doesn't run it again. The test pass takes several minutes and runs in parallel workers.

options.label: Skip it, rely on CI
options.description: Commit and open the PR on the checks already run. CI runs the full matrix. /pr's gate step is noted as skipped at your direction.

options.label: Run preflight only
options.description: Run the non-test gates (`hatch run preflight`) and skip the test suite, since no code changed.
